verdict.rationale: BVNK docs describe fiat payout rails (payout-overview, virtual accounts in USD/EUR/GBP, stablecoin-to-fiat settlement flows) confirming that off-ramp to local bank accounts is supported, but there is no single published table enumerating all supported countries or the full currency corridor list beyond USD/EUR/GBP mentions. missing for 10: a published country/currency coverage matrix, confirmation of local payout rails outside USD/EUR/GBP, and independent verification of settlement speed/coverage claims.
